[=Common Infrastructure That Is Actually Central=]

[.txt|SPO_CS/src/Common/.] is large, but these modules matter most for system behavior:

- [.txt|mParserGen.]
  parser combinators for SPO and IL
- [.txt|mTextParser.], [.txt|mTextStream.], [.txt|mSpan.]
  text and position model
- [.txt|mStream.], [.txt|mArrayList.], [.txt|mTreeMap.]
  core containers and traversal model
- [.txt|mResult.], [.txt|mMaybe.]
  error and optionality model
- [.txt|mFS.]
  file-based test and module paths
- [.txt|mTest.]
  test tree, execution, and CLI filtering

[=Recommended Onboarding Order in Code=]

o 1. [.txt|SPO_CS/src/mSPO_Interpreter.cs.]
   shows the whole SPO pipeline compactly
o 2. [.txt|SPO_CS/src/mSPO_Parser.cs.] and [.txt|SPO_CS/src/mSPO_AST.cs.]
   show the visible language
o 3. [.txt|SPO_CS/src/mSPO_Diagnostics.cs.] and [.txt|SPO_CS/src/mSPO_Navigation.cs.]
   show how parsed SPO is projected into editor-facing diagnostics and navigation
o 4. [.txt|SPO_CS/src/mSPO_Desugar.cs.]
   separates surface syntax from core language
o 5. [.txt|SPO_CS/src/mSPO_AST_Types.cs.] and [.txt|SPO_CS/src/mVM_Type.cs.]
   explain the actual semantics
o 6. [.txt|SPO_CS/src/mSPO2IL.cs.] and [.txt|SPO_CS/src/mIL_AST.cs.]
   show the backend boundary
o 7. [.txt|SPO_CS/src/mIL_GenerateOpcodes.cs.], [.txt|SPO_CS/src/mVM_Data.cs.], and [.txt|SPO_CS/src/mVM.cs.]
   explain the runtime
o 8. [.txt|SPO_CS/src/mModule.cs.] and [.txt|SPO_CS/src/mRegression.Tests.cs.]
   show real artifacts and verification wiring

[=Artifact Map=]

[| [*Path*] | [*Role*] |]
[| [.txt|SPO_CS/Modules/Std.ILT.] | canonical standard module directly in IL |]
[| [.txt|SPO_CS/Modules/Char.SPO.] + [.txt|Char.ILT.] | SPO module built on [.txt|Std.] plus checked canonical IL |]
[| [.txt|SPO_CS/Modules/Text.SPO.] + [.txt|Text.ILT.] | SPO module built on [.txt|Std.] and [.txt|Char.] plus checked canonical IL |]
[| [.txt|SPO_CS/Modules/Maybe.SPO.] + [.txt|Maybe.ILT.] | generic SPO module artifact plus canonical IL companion |]
[| [.txt|SPO_CS/Modules/Result.SPO.] | module artifact present on disk but not registered through [.txt|mModule.] |]
[| [.txt|SPO_CS/Regression.Tests/*.SPO.] | end-to-end source scenarios |]
[| [.txt|SPO_CS/Regression.Tests/*.result.SPO.] | expected semantics expressed in SPO |]
[| [.txt|SPO_CS/Regression.Tests/*.ILT.] | canonical lowering snapshots |]

Important distinction:

- [.txt|Std.] is loaded from `.ILT` directly in [.txt|mModule.]
- [.txt|Char.], [.txt|Text.], and [.txt|Maybe.] are loaded from `.SPO` and checked against sibling `.ILT`
- filesystem presence does not mean a module is registered in [.txt|mModule.]
- current health of those artifacts belongs in [<../40_verification/41_tests_and_artifacts.wiki|41_tests_and_artifacts.wiki>]

[=What This Map Makes Visible=]

- [.txt|mVM_Type.] is the central node of the system.
- [.txt|mIL_AST.] is the shared boundary between both frontends and the backend.
- [.txt|mModule.] sits at the top and only uses finished end-to-end entry points.
- the test structure mirrors the architecture: from parser and type tests up to real files and module graphs
- the repo has thin but relevant outer layers for host embedding, editor tooling, IDE test discovery, and browser-based doc viewing
